newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton settles lower in rangebound trade.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton settles lower in rangebound trade.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed down and near session lows but well within their current trading range as activity persisted in its recent pattern.
Floor sources said speculative selling and trade buying set the boundaries between 72.00 and 74.00 cents a lb for the March contract.
Technically, prices are seen heading closer to support, analysts said, but robust export business over several weeks could spark a rally, analysts said.
March cotton settled down 0.84 cent at 73.00 cents after trading from 74.00 to 72.88 cents. Deferreds dropped 0.78 to 0.04 cent.
